name: Frontier Station
description: A sci-fi starter on a station at the edge of known space: drones, scavengers, rogue AIs and a star leviathan, each with moves to read; salvaging wrecks, hacking servers and scanning nebulae; a fabricator and a research lab; EMP bursts to break enemy wind-ups; and the Hive Mind as the world boss.
tagline: Sci-fi frontier station: drones to a rogue AI, salvaging, hacking and a fabricator.

tools.name: Tools
tools.description: Cutters, decks and scanners for /gather. The best one in your bag counts.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.description: Gauze, antiseptic and a sticker that says 'you'll be fine'.

trauma-kit.name: Trauma Kit
trauma-kit.description: For when a medkit would just be optimistic.

data-shard.name: Data Shard
data-shard.description: A crash course in something. Plug in and learn.

pilot-visor.name: Pilot Visor
pilot-visor.description: Standard issue. Scratched in all the right places.

mag-boots.name: Mag Boots
mag-boots.description: Keeps you on the deck when the gravity doesn't.

pulse-pistol.name: Pulse Pistol
pulse-pistol.description: Reliable, loud, and very slightly warm.

riot-shield.name: Riot Shield
riot-shield.description: Station security surplus. Still has the decals.

exo-plate.name: Exo-Plate
exo-plate.description: Heavy armour plates on a servo frame.

rail-lance.name: Rail Lance
rail-lance.description: Accelerates a slug to rude speeds.

spacers-patch.name: Spacer's Patch
spacers-patch.description: Sewn on every jacket that's seen the black.

loader-plating.name: Loader Plating
loader-plating.description: Armour peeled off a cargo loader. Still dented.

leviathan-mantle.name: Leviathan Mantle
leviathan-mantle.description: Woven from a star leviathan's fin. It hums.

scrap-pistol.name: Scrap Pistol
scrap-pistol.description: Held together with tape and hope.

arc-rifle.name: Arc Rifle
arc-rifle.description: Fires a bolt that jumps between targets.

singularity-cannon.name: Singularity Cannon
singularity-cannon.description: Folds a little space where your enemy is standing.

composite-helmet.name: Composite Helmet
composite-helmet.description: Layered ceramic. Rated for most impacts.

flight-jacket.name: Flight Jacket
flight-jacket.description: Smells like engine grease and adventure.

aegis-exosuit.name: Aegis Exosuit
aegis-exosuit.description: A walking bunker with your name stencilled on it.

armored-greaves.name: Armored Greaves
armored-greaves.description: Shin guards for people who get shot at.

targeting-gloves.name: Targeting Gloves
targeting-gloves.description: Linked to your sights. Twitchy in a good way.

thruster-boots.name: Thruster Boots
thruster-boots.description: Short bursts. Don't hold the button.

phase-boots.name: Phase Boots
phase-boots.description: You arrive a moment before you left.

energy-barrier.name: Energy Barrier
energy-barrier.description: A hardlight shield on a wrist emitter.

bastion-projector.name: Bastion Projector
bastion-projector.description: A wall of light you carry around.

neural-link.name: Neural Link
neural-link.description: Learns faster than you do, then tells you.

bio-booster.name: Bio-Booster
bio-booster.description: Keeps your heart going, mostly in rhythm.

nanite-injector.name: Nanite Injector
nanite-injector.description: A billion tiny medics, all very keen.

neural-download.name: Neural Download
neural-download.description: Weeks of training in one uncomfortable minute.

bio-goo.name: Bio-Goo
bio-goo.description: Don't touch it with bare hands. Or at all.

scrap-plating.name: Scrap Plating
scrap-plating.description: Bent panels from a broken drone.

scav-tags.name: Scav Tags
scav-tags.description: Gang tags. Someone pays for these.

synth-fiber.name: Synth Fiber
synth-fiber.description: Spun by drones, stronger than steel cable.

void-essence.name: Void Essence
void-essence.description: Cold to the touch, and to the soul.

phase-blade.name: Phase Blade
phase-blade.description: Cuts through things that aren't fully there.

neural-crown.name: Neural Crown
neural-crown.description: The rogue AI's interface. It whispers suggestions.

scrap-metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap-metal.description: Worth almost nothing, until there's a lot of it.

circuit-board.name: Circuit Board
circuit-board.description: Still has a working chip or two.

quantum-crystal.name: Quantum Crystal
quantum-crystal.description: It's in two places. You only own one of them.

dark-matter.name: Dark Matter
dark-matter.description: Heavier than it looks. Much heavier.

access-key.name: Access Key
access-key.description: Opens a door somewhere on the station.

ai-fragment.name: AI Fragment
ai-fragment.description: A sliver of something that used to think.

ghost-protocol.name: Ghost Protocol
ghost-protocol.description: Code that shouldn't exist, signed by no one.

lichen.name: Lichen
lichen.description: Grows on anything, even vacuum-rated hulls.

lucky-isotope.name: Lucky Isotope
lucky-isotope.description: Decays at exactly the right moment.

thornvine.name: Thornvine
thornvine.description: Grabs at your suit as you pass.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.description: Lights the asteroid caves a soft blue.

nebula-bloom.name: Nebula Bloom
nebula-bloom.description: Only flowers inside the gas clouds.

stardust.name: Stardust
stardust.description: Literally. Scooped up with a scanner.

void-orchid.name: Void Orchid
void-orchid.description: Blooms in the dark between stars.

quantum-cutter.name: Quantum Cutter
quantum-cutter.description: The best cutter there is. +3 cuts.

cracking-deck.name: Cracking Deck
cracking-deck.description: Opens the Corporate Server. A wider window to breach.

breach-deck.name: Breach Deck
breach-deck.description: Opens the Black Site. A wider window still.

field-scanner.name: Field Scanner
field-scanner.description: Opens the Asteroid Field. More time per sweep.

deep-scanner.name: Deep Scanner
deep-scanner.description: Opens the Nebula. More time still.

tuned-pulse-pistol.name: Tuned Pulse Pistol
tuned-pulse-pistol.description: A fabricator's best work: hits harder.

dark-matter-lance.name: Dark Matter Lance
dark-matter-lance.description: Fires something that bends the light around it.

xeno-charm.name: Xeno Charm
xeno-charm.description: A botanist's keepsake. Sharpens the mind.

schematic-dark-matter-lance.name: Schematic: Dark Matter Lance
schematic-dark-matter-lance.description: Teaches the Fabricator to make a Dark Matter Lance.

orbital-uplink.name: Orbital Uplink
orbital-uplink.description: Teaches Orbital Strike: call the fleet down on one target.

alpha-hide.name: Alpha Hide
alpha-hide.description: From the biggest stalker in the jungle.

captains-blaster.name: Captain's Blaster
captains-blaster.description: Engraved, oiled, and very fast on the draw.

echo-shroud.name: Echo Shroud
echo-shroud.description: Stitched from a ghost ship's static.

hunters-dogtag.name: Hunter's Dogtag
hunters-dogtag.description: Proof you cleared the outer threats.

xenohide-jacket.name: Xenohide Jacket
xenohide-jacket.description: Stalker hide over a wire frame.

cell-powered-greaves.name: Cell-Powered Greaves
cell-powered-greaves.description: Power cells in the shins. Bouncy.

servo-helm.name: Servo Helm
servo-helm.description: A mech's servo bolted into a helmet.

titanium-cuirass.name: Titanium Cuirass
titanium-cuirass.description: Light enough to run in, hard enough to matter.

core-shield.name: Core Shield
core-shield.description: Powered by two AI cores. They argue.

void-mantle.name: Void Mantle
void-mantle.description: Woven void essence. Light bends around you.

arc-blast.name: Arc Blast
arc-blast.telegraph: charges an arc between its hands…

screech.name: Screech
screech.telegraph: throws back its head to screech…

self-repair.name: Self-Repair
self-repair.telegraph: repair arms start welding its wounds…

toxic-claw.name: Toxic Claw
toxic-claw.telegraph: drools and claws at the air…

synaptic-storm.name: Synaptic Storm
synaptic-storm.telegraph: every screen on the station turns white…

static-sweep.name: Static Sweep
static-sweep.telegraph: sweeps a wave of static across the deck.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.telegraph: raises a firewall around its core…

daily-patrol.name: Daily Patrol
daily-patrol.description: Clear whatever's crawling through the station today.

stalker-cull.name: Stalker Cull
stalker-cull.description: Rift stalkers keep getting into the hydro jungle. Thin them out.

scav-trouble.name: Scav Trouble
scav-trouble.description: Scavengers have been stripping the lower decks again.

quarantine.name: Hold the Quarantine
quarantine.description: Something keeps breaking out of the quarantine wing.

heavy-lifting.name: Heavy Lifting
heavy-lifting.description: The cargo loaders have gone rogue. Shut them down.

leviathan-hunter.name: Leviathan Hunter
leviathan-hunter.description: Bring down a star leviathan. The whole sector will hear of it.

silence-the-choir.name: Silence the Choir
silence-the-choir.description: Be there when the Hive Mind goes dark.

sim-champion.name: Sim Champion
sim-champion.description: Win three duels in the training sim.

scrap-drive.name: Scrap Drive
scrap-drive.description: The fabricator is short on alloy. Salvage some.

field-medic.name: Field Medic
field-medic.description: The med bay's running low. Synthesize medkits.

fabricator-commission.name: Fabricator Commission
fabricator-commission.description: A merc wants an ion carbine, and pays well.

sample-run.name: Sample Run
sample-run.description: The lab needs fresh samples from hydroponics, the asteroids and the nebula.

corporate-reserve.name: Corporate Reserve
corporate-reserve.description: Have 10,000 in your account at once.

fireteam.name: Fireteam
fireteam.description: Win a fight with a party.

words.hazardLine: Live wire! You drop half of what you salvaged.

traits.name: Packed holds
traits.line: The cargo's still strapped down: where there's one find, there's more beside it.

traits.name: Emergency lighting
traits.line: Red lights only: you can only cut next to what you've opened.

words.early: Too early: the firewall flagged you.

traits.name: Active countermeasures
traits.line: Their security fights back: it takes two clean breaches in a row.

traits.name: Honeypots
traits.line: Not every open port is real. Wait for the right one.

traits.name: Drifting rocks
traits.line: Scan the wrong rock and the whole field shifts.

traits.name: Ion haze
traits.line: You catch it on the scanner for a moment before the haze rolls back.

solar-flare.name: Solar Flare
solar-flare.line: A flare scrambles everything. Rough going, but rare signals come through.

ion-storm.name: Ion Storm
ion-storm.line: An ion storm blinds the sensors: you can barely see past your own hands.

clear-orbit.name: Clear Orbit
clear-orbit.line: Calm space, clean signals. An easy shift.

meteor-shower.name: Meteor Shower
meteor-shower.line: Rocks are hitting the hull. Dangerous, but they crack open fresh salvage.

supply-drop.name: Supply Drop
supply-drop.line: A supply ship came through: everything's plentiful, if you put the work in.

salvage-manifest.name: Salvage Manifest
salvage-manifest.description: Every part worth pulling out of a wreck.

xenobotany.name: Xenobotany
xenobotany.description: Every sample from hydroponics to the nebula. Fill it to learn the Xeno Charm.

threats-outer.name: Threat Database: Outer Decks
threats-outer.description: Beat every drone, scav and stalker of the outer decks.

threats-deep.name: Threat Database: Deep Threats
threats-deep.description: The quarantine wing, deep space, and the Hive Mind itself.

fabrication-log.name: Fabrication Log
fabrication-log.description: Every masterwork a fabricator can turn out.

custom-kit.name: Custom Kit
custom-kit.description: Every piece of armour the fabricator can make.

hive-mind.name: The Hive Mind
lines: We are many. You are one.

rogue-ai.name: Rogue AI
lines: I have calculated your defeat. Twice.
